title: "real_data_model_comp"

This markdown runs pairwise LOO model comparison (PBA vs WBA) for each participant.

```{r}
pacman::p_load(cmdstanr, tidyverse, posterior, loo, here)
```

```{r}
#load in draws
pba_draws_list <- readRDS(here("models_fit_to_data", "pba_empirical_draws.rds"))
wba_draws_list <- readRDS(here("models_fit_to_data", "wba_empirical_draws.rds"))

participant_ids <- names(pba_draws_list)

```

```{r}
# funct for extracting log_lik matrix (S x N) from a draws_df
extract_log_lik_matrix <- function(draws_df) {
  ll_cols <- grep("^log_lik\\[", names(draws_df), value = TRUE)
  idx     <- order(as.integer(gsub(".*\\[(\\d+)\\]", "\\1", ll_cols)))
  as.matrix(draws_df[, ll_cols[idx]])
}
```

```{r warning=FALSE} 

#disable warnings for loo compute

#empty list for storage
model_comparison_list <- list()


#loop over ids
for (id in participant_ids) {

  #print status
  cat("Participant", id, "\n")

  #get ll matrices
  pba_ll <- extract_log_lik_matrix(pba_draws_list[[id]])
  wba_ll <- extract_log_lik_matrix(wba_draws_list[[id]])

  #make loo computation
  pba_loo <- loo(pba_ll, cores = 1)
  wba_loo <- loo(wba_ll, cores = 1)

  #prep list for to feed
  loo_list   <- list(PBA = pba_loo, WBA = wba_loo)
  
  #make comparison and stacking weights
  comparison <- loo_compare(loo_list)
  weights    <- loo_model_weights(loo_list)
  
  
  #store comparison
  model_comparison_list[[id]] <- list(
    id         = id,
    comparison = comparison,
    weights    = weights,
    pba_loo    = pba_loo,
    wba_loo    = wba_loo
  )
}
```
Make dataframe of all comparsons
```{r}
# Build per-participant summary df for each partipant
summary_rows <- lapply(model_comparison_list, function(res) {
 
   #apply function to list
  
  comp <- res$comparison
  w    <- res$weights

  data.frame(
    ID              = res$id,
    PBA_elpd        = round(res$pba_loo$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"], 2),
    PBA_elpd_se     = round(res$pba_loo$estimates["elpd_loo", "SE"],       2),
    WBA_elpd        = round(res$wba_loo$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"], 2),
    WBA_elpd_se     = round(res$wba_loo$estimates["elpd_loo", "SE"],       2),
    elpd_diff       = round(comp[2, "elpd_diff"], 2),
    se_diff         = round(comp[2, "se_diff"],   2),
    winner          = rownames(comp)[1],
    PBA_stacking_w  = round(as.numeric(w["PBA"]), 3),
    WBA_stacking_w  = round(as.numeric(w["WBA"]), 3),
    
    
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

#bind rows of all dfs
per_participant_df <- bind_rows(summary_rows)

#write to csv
write_csv(per_participant_df, here("real_data_model_comparison_summary.csv"))
```

```{r}
param_rows <- lapply(participant_ids, function(id) {
  p_mean     <- mean(pba_draws_list[[id]]$p)
  rho_mean   <- mean(wba_draws_list[[id]]$rho)
  kappa_mean <- mean(wba_draws_list[[id]]$kappa)
  data.frame(ID = as.numeric(id), p = round(p_mean, 3), rho = round(rho_mean, 3), kappa = round(kappa_mean, 3))
})

params_df <- bind_rows(param_rows) %>%
  left_join(per_participant_df %>% select(ID, PBA_stacking_w, WBA_stacking_w, winner) %>% mutate(ID = as.numeric(ID)), by = "ID")

write_csv(params_df, here("participant_params_and_weights.csv"))
```


## Plots

```{r}
id_order <- per_participant_df %>% arrange(elpd_diff) %>% pull(ID)

ggplot(per_participant_df, aes(x = factor(ID, levels = id_order), y = elpd_diff)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = ifelse(winner == "PBA", "WBA", "PBA"))) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = elpd_diff - se_diff, ymax = elpd_diff + se_diff), width = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(x = "Participant", y = "ELPD Diff", fill = "Worse Model") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
weights_long <- per_participant_df %>%
  select(ID, PBA_stacking_w, WBA_stacking_w) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(PBA_stacking_w, WBA_stacking_w),
               names_to = "Model", values_to = "Stacking_weight") %>%
  mutate(Model = recode(Model, PBA_stacking_w = "PBA", WBA_stacking_w = "WBA"))

ggplot(weights_long, aes(x = factor(ID, levels = id_order), y = Stacking_weight, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  labs(x = "Participant", y = "Stacking weight") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
ggplot(params_df, aes(x = reorder(ID, kappa), y = kappa, fill = winner)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(x = "Participant", y = "Estimated kappa", fill = "Favored model") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
ggplot(params_df, aes(x = kappa, y = WBA_stacking_w)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(x = "Estimated kappa", y = "WBA stacking weight") +
  theme_minimal()
```
